A weathered dockside chandlery opens from the quay into a broad shop of brass fittings, coiled rope, and canvas. Behind it, a hard-working repair
  shop, sail loft, and deep stores form a compact maritime workshop.

layout.description:
A weathered dockside chandlery opens from the quay into a broad shop of brass fittings, coiled rope, and canvas. Behind it, a hard-working repair
  shop, sail loft, and deep stores form a compact maritime workshop.

rooms.name: Quayside Chandlery
rooms.style: The public shop is lined with squat superquadric shelving, brass hardware bins, lantern forms, and dense coils of rope. Salt-worn timber, muted teal walls, and oiled canvas awnings make it feel open to the harbour.

rooms.name: The Sail Loft
rooms.style: A long, bright workroom for cutting and stitching heavy oiled canvas, with broad low cutting tables, bundled cloth, and hanging sail panels. Its pale canvas surfaces are marked by navy seams and weathered wood.

rooms.name: Tarred Back Workshop
rooms.style: The back workshop repairs blocks, hooks, and rigging with chunky benches, vice-like forms, wooden pegs, and dark tarred barrels. It is cramped, smoky, and built from dark plank-like superquadrics with iron accents.
